dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Mostly on the left side of my head, especially around my temple.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: How long has it been there?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: About six hours. It began this morning.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes, quite nauseous, but I have not vomited.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Does bright light make it worse?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. Bright light makes the headache much worse and I prefer sitting in a dark room.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had weakness, numbness, difficulty speaking, or problems with your vision?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No weakness or numbness. I can speak normally and my vision is normal.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you experienced headaches like this before?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes, but usually they are less intense and normally improve after a few hours.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: All right. I will examine you and check for any warning signs before we decide on treatment.
